import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['y']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp])) for _ in range(1000)]
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
# author cluster bootstrap
a=w.author_key.unique(); ga={k:v for k,v in w.groupby('author_key')}
bs2=[]
for _ in range(500):
  s=rng.choice(a,len(a)); d=pd.concat([ga[k] for k in s])
  try: bs2.append(est(d))
  except: pass
print('author',np.percentile(bs2,[2.5,97.5]))
print('high conf',est(w[w.date_confidence=='high']))
print('excl other/collection',est(w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]))
print('window 1856-1896', est(w[(w.year>=1856)&(w.year<1896)]))
print('n_editions1',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.author_key.value_counts().head())
"
